vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A published CVE is a present risk; the cooldown exists to catch a hypothetical compromised release. Security updates therefore skip the age gate and the schedule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Most open alerts are transitive dependencies in package-lock.json, which no direct-dependency bump reaches. Automerged because the build job installs from the refreshed lock file and runs tsc against it.

packageRules.description: Docker digest age gate is unenforceable (renovate#38656); digest-cooldown workflow gates instead
Automerge minor for hono ecosystem (we follow upstream closely)
